title: Analyst, Audit AI OPS
description: About Coupang At Coupang, pricing decisions directly shape customer trust, category growth, market competitiveness, and long-term business trajectory. As pricing systems scale with sophisticated automation and data-driven models, identifying where customer outcomes, commercial performance, and market realities diverge requires forward-looking discovery beyond traditional reporting. The Audit Intelligence organization operates as an independent discovery engine across the pricing ecosystem. By leveraging AI technologies, advanced analytics, and rigorous audit methodologies, the team surfaces high-impact signals and empowers executive leadership to act on critical opportunities before they materialize into broader issues. Role Overview As an Audit Intelligence Analyst, you will build and run continuous intelligence systems that uncover customer trust opportunities, commercial growth vectors, competitive risks, and operational blind spots. Combining analytical rigor, business intuition, and AI-enabled workflows, you will convert large-scale operational and market data into high-value insights. Your work will directly guide pricing strategy, audit focus, and cross-functional execution. Collaborating with data engineers, AI agents, operations teams, and key stakeholders, you will detect weak signals in complex datasets before they impact customers or commercial performance. Why This Role Matters While traditional reporting explains past outcomes, this role anticipates future risks and opportunities. Operating guided by the Audit 2.0 core motto—"Find fast. Prove objectively. Escalate relentlessly. Drive fix that's permanent"—you will serve as a frontline catalyst for customer trust and price sharpness. Through synthesized customer, commercial, and market intelligence, you will safeguard customer trust and drive category competitiveness across Coupang's e-commerce landscape. What You Will Do Generate Customer Intelligence You will develop analytical frameworks that evaluate how pricing decisions influence customer trust, customer competitiveness, and long-term customer experience. Examples include, but are not limited to, identifying Blue Badge Trust risks where products may no longer meet customer trust expectations, surfacing pricing competitiveness gaps that impact customer conversion, detecting emerging price sharpness opportunities on highly trafficked pages, and identifying customer-facing pricing issues before they generate substantial dissatisfaction. Generate Commercial Intelligence You will identify commercial opportunities that improve growth, assortment quality, category performance, and customer adoption. Examples include, but are not limited to, identifying key products suffering from pricing-related performance challenges, surfacing underserved items experiencing abnormal demand declines on a MoM or YoY basis, identifying cold-start products requiring intervention, detecting seasonal recovery opportunities, and discovering long-tail or tail-of-tail products with unrealised commercial potential. Generate Market Intelligence You will continuously evaluate external competitive conditions and identify where Coupang is gaining or losing market competitiveness. Examples include, but are not limited to, competitiveness monitoring, comparative rank deterioration analysis, competitor promotion detection, external pricing movement analysis, category-level competitiveness shifts, and emerging market-share risk signals. Leverage AI Agents and Automation You will deploy modern LLMs and agentic workflows (GPT, Gemini, Kiro, Devin) to accelerate anomaly detection, automate repetitive investigations, and expand audit coverage. Examples include creating AI-assisted workflows that automatically investigate competitiveness losses, automate opportunity identification, generate summaries for leadership reviews, or support daily prioritization activities. Build Repeatable Intelligence Mechanisms You will help transform one-time analyses into scalable mechanisms that can continuously operate with minimal manual intervention. Examples include automated signal detection workflows, opportunity scoring systems, categorization frameworks, prioritization models, and intelligence dashboards used across Audit and Pricing organizations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Operations Excellence, Audit, Marketplace Operations, Pricing, Strategy, or related disciplines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets. Proficiency in SQL. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI-enabled analytical tools. Experience using Python or automation frameworks. Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. E-commerce, marketplace, retail, or pricing experience. Experience working with Machine Learning or Applied Science teams. Type of work model Hybrid Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work. title: Sr Analyst Product Support
description: Overview: POSITION SUMMARY STATEMENT: The Senior Product Support Analyst provides advanced technical and functional support for Herbalife digital applications to ensure reliable, high-quality, and customer-focused experiences for users across markets. This role is responsible for investigating, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and coordinating resolution for complex application issues affecting web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. The role owns escalated issues through investigation, communication, resolution, and closure; performs root-cause analysis; identifies recurring issues; and recommends product, process, automation, and operational improvements. The Senior Product Support Analyst partners closely with Product, Development, QA, Associate Services, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure issues are accurately documented, effectively escalated, and resolved in a timely manner. This position requires hands-on technical troubleshooting skills across web and mobile applications, backend services, databases, APIs, integrations, application logs, and monitoring tools. The individual must be able to use browser developer tools, console logs, SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, session-replay tools such as Quantum Metric, and logging/observability tools such as Splunk to investigate application behavior and customer-reported issues. The Senior Product Support Analyst may also support software projects and releases from requirements clarification through implementation, UAT, Hypercare, production validation, and ongoing maintenance. This role contributes to support documentation, reporting, and enhancement recommendations that improve application usability, reliability, and customer experience. DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES: Serve as a subject-matter expert for assigned digital applications and provide Level 2 technical and functional support for web, mobile, consumer-facing, backend, and integrated applications. Own customer-reported issues from initial investigation through resolution and closure, ensuring timely communication, clear expectations, and a strong customer experience. Diagnose and troubleshoot complex application incidents, defects, service requests, and escalations using browser developer tools, console logs, network traces, application logs, dashboards, and monitoring tools. Investigate application behavior across frontend components, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication flows, and third-party dependencies. Use SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Postman, and similar technical tools to validate data, troubleshoot APIs, analyze application behavior, reproduce issues, and support root-cause analysis. Use session-replay and digital-experience tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), and logging/observability tools, such as Splunk, to analyze customer journeys, identify technical errors, validate reported issues, and detect recurring trends. Provide Product, and Development teams with complete and actionable issue details, including business impact, reproducible steps, expected versus actual behavior, screenshots, logs, timestamps, API responses, and relevant data findings. Identify recurring defects, known errors, customer pain points, and support trends; recommend permanent corrective actions, product enhancements, process improvements, automation opportunities, and preventive measures. Participate in incident reviews and root-cause analysis; document and track corrective and preventive actions through completion. Support release-readiness activities, including requirements clarification, UAT, production validation, Hypercare, post-release monitoring, and stabilization support. Partner closely with Product Managers, Developers, Operations, Associate Services, and business stakeholders to investigate issues, clarify business rules, coordinate resolution, and improve product usability and reliability. Create and maintain knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, runbooks, known-error records, support procedures, reports, dashboards, and self-help materials. Contribute to support and product documentation, including user stories, use cases, process maps, requirements, acceptance criteria, application gap analysis, and enhancement requests. Identify and support automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve support efficiency, strengthen monitoring, and accelerate issue detection and resolution. Qualifications: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Skills (Required): Strong functional and technical understanding of digital applications, system-support processes, and application-maintenance practices. Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting web-based and mobile applications. Strong understanding of digital application architecture, including frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, and third-party dependencies. Experience using browser developer tools, application consoles, console logs, network traces, and error diagnostics. Strong SQL skills for data investigation, validation, troubleshooting, reporting, and root-cause analysis. Working experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Working knowledge of JavaScript for browser-console troubleshooting, scripting, automation, or diagnostic activities. Hands-on experience using Postman or similar API tools for testing, validation, and troubleshooting of REST APIs and integrations. Experience using session-replay or digital-experience analytics tools, such as Quantum Metric (QM), FullStory, Dynatrace Session Replay, or similar tools. Experience using logging, monitoring, and observability tools, such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Kibana/Elastic, or similar platforms. Ability to analyze and correlate session-replay data, application logs, browser-console output, network traces, APIs, backend services, and database data to diagnose complex issues. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify recurring issues and recommend process, product, monitoring, automation, or operational improvements. Demonstrated ability to achieve results with limited supervision. Ability to effectively manage multiple, competing, high-priority issues and projects with varying deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and simplify technical concepts for non-technical audiences. Ability to interact effectively with individuals from different countries and cultures, with sensitivity to cultural diversity. Strong interpersonal, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills. Strong work ethic with emphasis on customer service, quality, ownership, and timely resolution. Ability to function effectively as a collaborative team member. Motivated self-starter with initiative, curiosity, and the ability to learn new technologies, applications, and business processes quickly. Thorough knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle methodologies, Agile delivery practices, and information-systems concepts and terminology. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio. Skills (Preferred): Experience in enterprise Internet, e-commerce, consumer-facing, web, or mobile application environments. Experience with .NET client/server, cloud-based, and service-oriented application environments. Experience with enterprise content-management systems. Experience: 8+ years of experience in application support, technical support, product support, software engineering support, systems analysis, or a related technology role. 5+ years supporting enterprise, e-commerce, consumer-facing, web, mobile, SaaS, or integrated digital applications. Experience investigating production issues involving APIs, databases, integrations, application logs, and backend services. Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and business teams to resolve complex technical issues. Experience in incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem management. Experience in creating support documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, or operational runbooks. Experience supporting software releases, UAT, Hypercare, and post-production stabilization. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant work experience may be considered. Cloud Security Infrastructure Expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) AWS Security: Hands-on experience investigating alerts from AWS Security Hub, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and IAM Policy/Permission boundaries. title: Senior Lead – Analytics & Commercial Insights
description: Role Summary Responsible for building and independently driving the Analytics function from the ground up, owning the data strategy and generating meaningful brand- and campaign-specific insights. The role involves consolidating multiple data sources, building data models, analysing consumer and campaign performance, establishing ROI benchmarks and translating complex data into commercially relevant insights and actionable business recommendations. The individual will be expected to identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, drive client engagement and generate business value through data-led recommendations. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong analytical capabilities, commercial acumen, stakeholder management and the ability to operate independently in a lean, entrepreneurial environment. KRAs (Key Responsibility Areas) 1. Build and Establish the Analytics Function Set up and independently drive the Analytics function from scratch. Define the data strategy, analytical frameworks, processes and measurement methodologies. Establish standardised campaign KPIs and performance measurement frameworks. Build scalable analytical processes and take complete ownership of the function. Work independently in a lean environment with minimal support. 2. Data Consolidation, Modelling & Management Personally consolidate data from multiple, fragmented and unstructured sources. Build structured datasets, data models and analytical frameworks. Perform data cleaning, transformation, reconciliation and validation. Ensure extremely high standards of data accuracy, consistency and reliability. Identify discrepancies, investigate data gaps and establish robust data quality processes. 3. Campaign & Consumer Analytics Analyse consumer behaviour, engagement patterns, purchase trends and campaign performance. Interpret behavioural, performance and funnel data to identify meaningful trends and opportunities. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, engagement, participation, conversion and ROI. Develop analytical models for customer segmentation, retention, propensity, churn and customer lifetime value. Identify opportunities to improve campaign targeting, engagement and overall performance. 4. Commercial Insights & Business Recommendations Proactively identify meaningful and commercially relevant insights that brands can derive value from. Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations rather than limiting outputs to dashboards and reports. Identify opportunities for revenue growth, profitability improvement and campaign optimisation. Develop brand-level insights, ROI benchmarks and performance reports. Create industry benchmark reports and analytical inputs to support Business Development and Client Servicing teams. Identify potential upselling opportunities and new business opportunities through data-driven insights. 5. Predictive Analytics, Forecasting & AI Apply statistical techniques, predictive analytics and forecasting to identify trends and anticipate business outcomes. Develop models to support campaign uplift, customer behaviour analysis, performance optimisation and business planning. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning applications to unlock value from existing datasets. Identify opportunities to automate analytical workflows and improve the efficiency and quality of insight generation. 6. Client & Stakeholder Management Present analytical findings, insights and recommendations confidently to clients and internal stakeholders. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, commercially relevant business narratives. Confidently explain and defend recommendations using data, evidence and business rationale. Work closely with Business Development, Client Servicing and internal teams to understand business requirements. Ensure analytical recommendations are relevant, accurate and aligned with client expectations. 7. Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement Deliver regular actionable insight reports to internal teams and clients. Drive campaign performance improvement initiatives through data-led recommendations. Monitor campaign KPIs, engagement, participation, conversion and ROI. Continuously improve analytical processes, measurement standards and reporting accuracy. Ensure insights are implemented and their business impact is tracked. KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) Percentage of campaigns with actionable insights identified and implemented. Average uplift in engagement and participation resulting from analytical recommendations. Improvement in campaign performance, conversion and ROI. Number of upsell opportunities and business opportunities generated through data-led insights. Accuracy, consistency and reliability of consolidated data and analytical outputs. Timeliness and quality of actionable insight reports. Adoption and utilisation of analytical recommendations by internal teams and clients. Internal stakeholder satisfaction across Business Development, Client Servicing and other teams. Client feedback on the quality, relevance and commercial value of insights. Successful establishment and adoption of standardised analytics frameworks and processes. Key Skills & Experience 6+ years of relevant experience in Analytics, Business Analytics, Consumer Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics or related areas. Proven ability to independently establish and drive an analytics function, capability or analytical processes from scratch. Strong hands-on experience in consolidating multiple data sources, building data models and performing end-to-end analysis. Strong proficiency in SQL, Excel and Python for data extraction, manipulation and analysis. Proficiency in data visualisation and BI tools such as Power BI, GA4, Metabase, Looker or Tableau. Strong understanding of statistical analysis, predictive modelling, forecasting and machine learning techniques. Practical exposure to AI-driven analytics, automation or machine learning applications. Ability to interpret behavioural, performance and funnel data and derive meaningful insights. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate numbers into actionable business recommendations. Excellent data accuracy, reconciliation, validation and quality assurance capabilities. Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present and defend insights. Ability to work independently, demonstrate resourcefulness and take complete ownership in a lean, entrepreneurial environment. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a hands-on, commercially minded analytics professional who can independently build and run the Analytics function. The ideal candidate should be capable of consolidating data from multiple sources, building analytical models, asking the right business questions, identifying valuable insights and translating them into actionable recommendations for brands and clients. The role requires someone who combines technical execution with commercial thinking, strong communication skills, resourcefulness and an ownership mindset.
